description: An exciting opportunity awaits a dedicated Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) in Gainesville, FL. description:

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, committed to providing exceptional patient care. description:

Ability to manage a team and departmental operations effectively

description:
